name: Blood Curse of the Eyeless
description:
When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you succeeds on an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to roll one hemocraft die and subtract the number rolled from the creature’s attack roll, potentially turning the success into a failure. The creature is immune to this curse if it is immune to the Blinded condition
	**Amplify**: You apply this curse to all the creature’s attack rolls until the end of the creature’s turn. You roll separately for each affected attack.
